To obtain warranty ... Through this webpage, addlink will provide warranty service from it headquarter. In this case, you will have to pay the cost of transportation and relevant insurance for delivering the product to addlink, and addlink will pay for the cost of transportation and relevant insurance for returning the product back to you after warranty service completion. Please confirm the terms of its return policies before returning the product. Usually, you must include product identification information, such as the model number and serial number (if applicable) with a detail description of the problem that you are experiencing. You will also need to provide proof of purchase. To the extent permitted by applicable laws, products that are not imported or sold through authorized addlink dealers or distributors are not covered by this warranty, and addlink may choose to repair or replace your product for a fee. ### Limited Warranty Condition

The limited warranty period for Solid State Storage ends when either of the 
following occurs: 
(a) the time limit specified by the warranty expires, or (b) the Solid-State Storage 
reaches its endurance limit (TBW – Total Bytes Written). TBW is a measure of the 
SSD's expected lifespan. The SSD SMART percentage used value, as indicated by 
CrystalDiskInfo or addlink's toolbox, reflects the TBW status. 
Reference tools: 
• CrystalDiskInfo: https://crystalmark.info/en/software/crystaldiskinfo/ 
• addlink SSD Toolbox: https://www.addlink.com.tw/ssdtoolbox Checking SSD Remaining Lifespan Using either CrystalDiskInfo or the addlink Toolbox, locate the Percentage Used value (SMART attribute ID 05): 
• Percentage Used = 0: New, unused product — full TBW lifespan remaining. 
• Percentage Used ≥ 100: Drive has reached or exceeded its TBW endurance limit. Warranty coverage for endurance-related failures ends at this point. 

#### Duration of Warranty

The duration of the warranty for Solid State Storage is limited and ends at the earlier of two conditions: either the time limit specified by warranty expires, or the product reaches its endurance limit.
